headline.en: Apps that hold up in production.

challenges.en: Keeping four apps in sync on one data model

summary.en: Accounting system linking a central warehouse to multiple point-of-sale terminals, built offline-first with automatic sync.

challenges.en: Financial calculations that must reconcile exactly
challenges.ar: حسابات مالية يجب أن تتطابق بدقة

summary.en: Corporate website for a technology and logistics company, covering services and delivered work.

description.en: Led the development team across multiple projects and set the architecture for scalable delivery.
description.ar: قيادة فريق التطوير عبر عدة مشاريع، ووضع المعمارية اللازمة للتسليم القابل للتوسّع.

description.en: Built and maintained Flutter applications for a range of client briefs.
